title: Add source-verified Finance knowledge and review domain
summary: Adds a Microsoft-owned Finance knowledge domain with nine articles, each paired with bad and good AL samples, plus a new al-finance-review skill. The articles cover posting ledger entries, dimension sets, applying entries, due dates, reversals, journal balance and Normal VAT amounts.
key_points: Nine Finance articles with eighteen bad/good AL sample companions
Rules target mistakes like direct ledger modification, copying only shortcut dimensions and fabricated settlement via status flags
New al-finance-review skill for reviewing code in the Finance domain
Finance owns G/L, customer/vendor, detailed and VAT records; item, value and warehouse records stay with SCM
All Finance articles use application-area all; leaf-count diagnostics follow the conventions from #192
quote: Nine atomic articles, eighteen original AL companions, and `al-finance-review`.
